timeline.comment: Read the exact detected header and its optional ASCII-separated direction; statement-prefix directives retain their scopes. timeline.md#detection: The header may carry a **direction**: one or more spaces or tabs after `timeline` and then the keyword `LR` or `TD`, compared case-insensitively and not followed by a word character.

patterns.comment: Read a native hash comment only outside entity text; values in other contexts keep their hashes. timeline.md#the-statement-context: A `#` ends a period and starts a comment, so `a #c : e` has the period `a ` and no event, while a `#` inside a title text, a section text, an event text, or an accessibility text is a character: `title T # c`, `section S # c`, `a : e # c`, `a : #`, and `title #my#title#` keep it.

Read a native percent comment without exposing a directive as its mark. timeline.md#the-statement-context: `%`, not followed by `{`: a diagram comment, from the `%` to the end of the line (see [Comments](#comments)): `% c`, `%c`, and `%` alone are comments, also between a period and its event line and after the header.

Read title after its one required whitespace character and nonempty text, leaving a separator-led comment boundary outside the value. timeline.md#the-statement-context: `title`, one whitespace character, line feed included, and one or more characters other than a line feed: a `title` unit and a `title-text` unit, whose text is the characters after the one whitespace character.

Read section after its one required whitespace character and nonempty text up to colon; a bare word remains period text. timeline.md#the-statement-context: `section`, one whitespace character, line feed included, and one or more characters other than `:` and a line feed: a `section` unit and a `section-text` unit, whose text is the characters after the one whitespace character.

Read a case-insensitive description block and its text delimiters after leading padding; stop value scope at a separator-led comment boundary. timeline.md#the-statement-context: `accDescr`, zero or more whitespace characters, line feeds included, `{`, and zero or more whitespace characters, line feeds included: an `accDescr` unit and a `{` unit; enters the description block context. timeline.md#accessibility-values: `}`: a `}` unit; leaves the context.

Read description text up to the first closing brace or common-comment boundary, keeping the enclosing block open across the comment. timeline.md#accessibility-values: One or more characters other than `}`, line feeds included: an `acc-description-block-text` unit.

Read accessibility line text with case-insensitive keywords, leaving padding outside the value and keeping inline percent pairs. timeline.md#accessibility-values: In the title context and in the description context, the one rule is: one or more characters other than a line feed: an `acc-title-text` unit in the title context, an `acc-description-text` unit in the description context; leaves the context.

Read an event colon and its one required whitespace character, ending the text at a following event colon or common-comment boundary. timeline.md#the-statement-context: `:`, one whitespace character, line feed included, and the **event text**: one or more characters, each a character other than `:` and a line feed or a `:` that no whitespace follows: a `:` unit and an `event-text` unit.

Read a complete period as unquoted text, keeping joined directives and entities inside the period rather than exposing keywords or comments. timeline.md#periods-and-events: A period is the text of its unit as written, the whitespace before the colon, `#`, or line feed included, which the Db keeps; the whitespace before it is outside it.
